patch_description: Crossover of the current program (binary search + best-fit packing + local-search refinement) with the best-fit-threshold packing from the inspiration program. The key fix is that the inspiration program crashes with float division by zero when a GPU's free memory hits zero (val = (W+w)/(rem-s) with rem==s). I adopt its best-fit selection inside the feasibility packer (choosing the GPU with the smallest resulting KVPR rather than first-fit), but guard all divisions with a safe_ratio helper returning infinity for non-positive free memory. Then I run binary search on the threshold lambda (60 iterations) and finish with the current program's local-search refinement that moves models off the hottest GPU whenever it strictly lowers the global max KVPR. This combines the stronger packing heuristic of the inspiration with the refinement of the current best program while eliminating the crash.
